import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve() -> None:
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1

    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            if j != i:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i][j - 1]
            if i != 0:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j]
            dp[i][j] %= MOD

    ans = 0
    for j in range(n, -1, -1):
        for i in range(j - 1, -1, -2):
            ans += dp[i][j]
            ans %= MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
